job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
About the opportunity

A large government agency is modernising a long-standing, customer-facing service environment as part of a multi-year digital transformation agenda. The work goes well beyond technology, reshaping business processes, workforce capability, data use and legislative responsiveness. Several Project Managers are being engaged, each leading a defined project Pathway from Start Up through to Completion. You will work alongside Product and Service Owners in a PRINCE2 environment that applies agile delivery practices. This is a multi year program.

The role
  • Lead delivery of your project Pathway end to end, to agreed scope, schedule, quality, budget and benefit targets
  • Coordinate delivery teams and a working group, giving clear direction and decisions
  • Manage risks, issues, dependencies, change requests and priorities
  • Own the project budget, schedule and resource allocation
  • Report accurately to the Project Board, Senior Users and senior management, with governance and assurance in place
What you'll bring
  • PRINCE2 Practitioner certification
  • Delivery of complex technology transformation, including migration from legacy systems to contemporary platforms
  • Referenceable projects you have led from commencement to completion in complex regulated and/or government environments
Highly regarded: public and private sector experience, project tools such as MS Project and Jira/Confluence, leading teams across the full project lifecycle, and a Scrum Master or similar agile qualification.

About you:

What you’ll bring:

Engineering & delivery
  • Strong software engineering experience in Java/C# and modern frontend frameworks such as Angular or React
  • Experience building full stack applications, including responsive user interfaces, backend services and API integrations
  • Solid understanding of software design principles, object-oriented programming, clean code practices and secure development standards
  • Experience designing, building and consuming RESTful APIs and microservices in enterprise environments
  • Familiarity with additional languages or frameworks such as TypeScript, JavaScript, Python or Node.js is highly regarded
  • Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP, including deploying and operating modern applications in cloud environments
  • Understanding of solution design, systems integration and application architecture, with the ability to contribute to technical design decisions
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, version control and modern engineering toolchains
  • Strong estimation, planning and delivery skills, with the ability to break down work and contribute to agile delivery teams
  • A quality-focused mindset with experience in debugging, performance optimisation and building reliable, maintainable software
Consulting & stakeholder engagement:
  • Confidence engaging with stakeholders to clarify requirements, explain technical concepts and support effective delivery outcomes.
  • Strong communication and consulting skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across business and technical teams.
  • Interest in working in client-facing environments and growing into Forward Deployed Engineering roles, with training and support provided.
Nice to Have:
  • Exposure to AI-enabled applications, developer productivity tools or LLM-based solutions is a plus, but not essential

If this role interest you "APPLY" below with an updated Cv or contact Guy Nardo on 0452 664 264 for a confidential chat.

Apply now to shape platform architecture on a 12-month contract in Canberra.

job.title: Security Engineer
job.description:
About the opportunity
My client is looking for a hands-on Cyber Security Engineer to take operational ownership of its security platforms and technical controls. You'll sit in a cloud and security focused team within the wider technology group, working alongside a Security Analyst and other technology teams to review risks, identify gaps and put the right controls in place. It's an engineering role across the full lifecycle, from design and tool selection through to deployment, optimisation and remediation, using technologies including Microsoft Defender, Entra ID and Intune. The work supports an organisation whose purpose is to walk alongside people in need.


The role
  • Take technical ownership of assigned security technologies, driving improvement through hardening, automation and documentation
  • Design, implement and optimise controls across endpoint, identity, cloud, network and security monitoring
  • Run vulnerability management from scanning and analysis through to prioritisation and remediation
  • Investigate and respond to security incidents, with root cause analysis and preventative fixes
  • Deliver security projects including upgrades, migrations and hardening, and mentor colleagues across the technology group
  • Drive AI adoption
What you'll bring
  • Hands-on experience in a Cyber Security, Systems or Network Engineering role within a complex enterprise environment
  • Practical depth in the Microsoft security stack: Defender, Entra ID and Active Directory, Intune, Microsoft 365 and Azure security
  • Experience across EDR, SIEM, vulnerability management, firewalls and VPN, email and web security, and Windows Server hardening
  • Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills, with PowerShell or similar scripting to automate security and operational tasks
  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, plus solid documentation and change management habits
Degree in IT or Cyber Security (or equivalent experience) preferred. Security+, SC-200, SC-300, AZ-500, CCNA or CISSP are highly regarded. A current driver's licence, relevant probity checks and proof of vaccination status where required also apply.

Culture
A collaborative technology team where you're trusted to own your platforms and work independently, share knowledge across teams, and speak up with ideas in an environment where it's safe to do so.

  • Improving operational processes, service performance and customer outcomes.

  • Maintaining compliance with NSW security industry regulations, WHS requirements and relevant standards.

* Coordinating equipment requirements for OB productions, fly-away kits and live events.
* Preparing, testing, packing and dispatching production equipment.
* Managing asset registers, equipment maintenance, repairs and servicing.
* Sourcing cross-hire equipment and managing suppliers and freight.
* Forecasting equipment requirements and monitoring utilisation.
* Improving operational processes, systems and reporting.

You’re proactive, organised and comfortable working in fast-paced production environments. You understand the importance of planning ahead, solving problems and ensuring everything is ready when the production goes live.

Essential: Demonstrated Outside Broadcast (OB) experience in broadcast, sports production or live events.

* Working knowledge of broadcast equipment, including cameras, vision, audio, replay and communications systems.
* Experience with asset management or rental platforms such as Current RMS, Flex or similar.
* Strong organisational, planning and supplier management skills.
* A current driver’s licence.

Why Apply?
Get involved in exciting sports broadcasts and major live events.
Work alongside experienced technical and production teams.
Take ownership of equipment and operational logistics.
Help improve systems and processes within a growing business.
The role may involve out-of-hours work and intrastate, interstate and occasional international travel.

Have the OB experience and technical know-how to keep productions moving? Apply now!

You will extend and develop Keycloak or Red Hat SSO, build reactive Java microservices and RESTful APIs, and work with product leadership on where the platforms go next. The environment demands high availability and strong security assurance, so engineering discipline matters as much as technical depth.

The role
  • Shape the direction of product development, enhancements and support for shared identity and microservice platforms, alongside the Product Manager and Directors
  • Extend and develop identity capability in Keycloak or Red Hat SSO
  • Design and build Java/JEE reactive microservices and RESTful APIs
  • Keep the platforms available and reliable, including on call and after hours support as required
  • Make sure operations, processes and practices meet relevant legislative and government standards
What you'll bring
  • High level expertise extending or developing in Keycloak or Red Hat SSO, ideally with other (especially open source) Identity Management platforms
  • Knowledge of identity federation and protocols: OpenID Connect, OAuth, SAML and Verifiable Credentials
  • High level expertise in Java/JEE, reactive microservices and RESTful APIs
  • Experience supporting platforms at high availability in high security assurance environments, including identity trust frameworks
  • Experience with UI libraries and design systems (HTML5, CSS frameworks, responsive design), and working in an agile and DevSecOps environment
Highly desirable: Spring Boot, Maven, Postgres, JUnit and Selenium/Playwright, Linux/Unix, plus AWS (or Azure/GCP), Kubernetes and GitHub Actions CI/CD.

  • Constant iteration and improvement in how products and services are delivered

  • Respectful, inclusive workplace that values diversity
  • Regular collaboration with product and director level stakeholders
